name: has_terminal_object
description: True if the category has a terminal object.

name: is_initial
description: True if the category is empty (i.e. has no morphisms).

name: has_finite_products
description: True if the category has all finite products. Equivalent to having a terminal object and all binary products.

name: has_binary_products
description: True if the category has binary products.

name: has_binary_coproducts
description: True if the category has binary coproducts.

name: is_cocomplete
description: True if the category is cocomplete. Because we only consider finite categories, this is equivalent to having finite coproducts and coequalizers.

name: has_equalizers
description: True if the category has an equalizer of each pair of parallel morphisms.

name: has_coequalizers
description: True if the category has a coequalizer of every parallel pair of morphisms.

name: is_monoid
description: True if the category is a monoid (i.e. has exactly one object).

name: is_connected
description: True if the category is connected (i.e. the underlying quiver is connected).

name: is_groupoid
description: True if the category is a groupoid (i.e. all morphisms are isomorphisms).

name: is_skeletal
description: True if the category is skeletal (i.e. all isomorphisms are endomorphisms).

name: has_initial_object
description: True if the category has an initial object.

name: is_complete
description: True if the category is complete. Because we only consider finite categories, this is equivalent to having finite products and equalizers.

name: is_discrete
description: True if the category is discrete (i.e. has no non-identity morphisms).

name: is_preorder
description: True if the category is a preorder (i.e. every hom set has cardinality at most 1).

name: has_finite_coproducts
description: True if the category has all finite coproducts. Equivalent to having a initial object and all binary coproducts.

name: is_terminal
description: True if the category has exactly one object and exactly one morphism (i.e. is the one-point category).
